design.trust_windows: 10 transitions before and after injection; mean genetic weights over valid neighbors
design.assortment: time-mean strictly adjacent unordered pairs over observed living states; no equilibrium claim
design.inference: paired independent training-seed summaries, exploratory unadjusted tests; five units only
design.placement_control: random global empty-cell placement changes only offspring placement
design.placement_design_note: Matched high reserve exercises reproduction; low-reserve exploratory check had only 0-1 births per seed. This is a diagnostic regime, not a confirmatory test.
design.trust_limit: composition-sensitive population weight change, not within-individual learning

incentive_response.note: Independent policies trained at each B/C, paired by seed; fixed synthetic inputs; B/C absent from observations. Training-condition response, not instantaneous incentive sensitivity or proof of Hamilton's rule.
